requirements.title: Shop Standards for Metal Ductwork
requirements.requirement_text: Submit Shop Standards for metal ductwork including gages, materials, type of joints, sealing requirements, method of fabrication and reinforcing. Shop standards shall be in accordance with the SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards, 2005 Edition.

requirements.title: Manufacturer's Product Data and Installation Instructions
requirements.requirement_text: Submit manufacturer's product data for factoryfabricated single wall round ductwork, duct sealant and cement, gasket materials, duct liner and sound traps; and installation instructions.

requirements.title: ACGIH Figure Numbers for Hoods
requirements.requirement_text: Include American Conference of Governmental Industrial Hygienists (ACGIH) figure numbers for hoods if applicable.

requirements.title: Product Data for Fire-Resistive Duct Assemblies
requirements.requirement_text: Submit product data for factory manufactured commercial Fire-Resistive Duct Assemblies.

requirements.title: Scaled Layout Drawings of Metal Ductwork and Fittings
requirements.requirement_text: Submit scaled layout drawings (3/8"=1') of metal ductwork and fittings including but not limited to duct sizes, locations, elevations, slopes of horizontal runs, wall and floor penetrations, and connections, including location of connections. Show modifications of indicated requirements, made to conform to local shop practice and how those modifications ensure that free area, materials and rigidity are not reduced.

requirements.title: Duct Hanger Attachment Shop Drawings
requirements.requirement_text: Method of attachment of duct hangers to building construction with all the support details including methods for vibration isolation, cable hanging systems and seismic restraints.

requirements.title: ICC Certification for Expansion Bolts
requirements.requirement_text: For expansion bolts installed in concrete, submit ICC certification for use in cracked concrete.
requirements.condition: For expansion bolts installed in concrete

requirements.title: Layout and Fabrication Details for Kitchen Exhaust Ducts
requirements.requirement_text: Layout and fabrication details for kitchen exhaust ducts.

requirements.title: Shop Manufactured Method of Fabrication for Fire-Resistive Duct Assemblies
requirements.requirement_text: Submit shop manufactured method of fabrication for Fire-Resistive Duct Assemblies.

requirements.title: Shop Drawings for Roof Openings
requirements.requirement_text: HVAC Contractor shall provide shop drawings for all roof openings required for installation of HVAC systems. Roof opening shop drawings shall be dimensioned from the centerline of the nearest structural column and coordinated with the approved HVAC equipment, sheet metal shop drawings, framing plan, etc.

requirements.title: Duct Leakage Tests
requirements.requirement_text: Duct Leakage Tests: Refer to Section 15992, Cleaning and Testing.

products.name: Aluminum
products.description: ASTM B209, Alloy 3003, Temper H-14 sheet form with standard, one-side bright finish for ducts exposed to view and with mill finish for concealed ducts.

products.name: Galvanized Steel
products.description: Lock-forming quality; ASTM A653 G60 coating designation; mill-phosphatized finish for surfaces of ducts exposed to view.

products.name: Stainless Steel
products.description: ASTM A480, Type 316, sheet form with No. 4 finish for surfaces of ducts exposed to view; and Type 304, sheet form with No.1 finish for concealed ducts.

products.name: Reinforcement Shapes and Plates
products.description: Galvanized steel reinforcement where installed on galvanized, sheet metal ducts; compatible materials for aluminum and stainless-steel ducts.

products.name: Tie Rods
products.description: Galvanized steel, 1/4" minimum diameter for 36" length or less; 3/8" minimum diameter for lengths longer than 36".

products.name: Hangers (Indoor Finishes)
products.description: Zinc plated in accordance with ASTM B633 or electro-deposited green epoxy finish the equal of Cooper B-Line series Dura Green.

products.name: Strut Channels and Angles (Indoor Finishes)
products.description: Pregalvanized in accordance with ASTM A653 Grade 33 G90 or electrodeposited green epoxy finish the equal of Cooper B-Line series Dura Green.

products.name: Hangers (Outdoor Finishes)
products.description: Hot dipped galvanized after fabrication in accordance with ASTM A123 or Stainless Steel Type 304.

products.name: Strut Channels and Angles (Outdoor Finishes)
products.description: Hot dipped galvanized after fabrication in accordance with ASTM A123 or Stainless Steel Type 304.

products.name: Hangers (Corrosive Area Finishes)
products.description: Stainless Steel Type 316.

products.name: Strut Channels and Angles (Corrosive Area Finishes)
products.normalized_name: Strut Channels and Angles (Corrosive Area Finishes)
products.description: Stainless Steel Type 316.

products.name: Rod Type Hangers and Angles
products.description: Shall utilize two locking nuts in place.

products.name: Inserts for new conventional reinforced poured concrete slabs
products.normalized_name: Inserts for new conventional reinforced poured concrete slabs
products.description: Carpenter & Paterson Inc. No. 650; Anvil International Fig. 281; C. H. Leibfried Mfg. Corp. No. 100; Cooper B-Line, Inc. B2500 & N2500 Series.

products.name: Inserts for new composite metal decks
products.normalized_name: Inserts for new composite metal decks
products.description: Powers Fasteners 'BangIt' or Hilti, Inc. Cast-In Anchor HCI-WF (or approved equal).

products.name: Expansion Bolts (wedge-type zinc-coated fastener)
products.description: Wedge-type zinc-coated fastener with pull-out, tension, and shear capacities appropriate for supported loads and building materials where used: ITW Ramset/Red Head 'Trubolt+'; Hilti, Inc 'Kwik Bolt 3', Dewalt 'Power Stud+ SD2'; Allfasteners, 'ETB Wedge Anchors' or approved equal. Installed in accordance with Appendix D of ACI 318-14.

products.name: Stainless Steel Expansion Bolts
products.description: Fully threaded, torque-controlled, wedge-type expansion anchor consisting of a high-strength threaded stud body, stainless steel expansion elements (clip, wedge), nut and washer. Installed in accordance with Appendix D of ACI 318-14. Manufacturers: 'Trubolt+' by ITW Ramset/Red Head; 'Kwik Bolt 3' by Hilti, Inc.; 'Power Stud+ SD2' by Powers Fasteners, Inc.

products.name: Cable Hanging Systems (Gripple)
products.description: Cable Hanging Systems with adjustable mechanical devices compliant with SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards Third Edition-2005 shall consist of ready-to-use factory tested kit comprising of cable and cable end options. Crimps shall be Factory installed. All cable hanger products shall be certified as SMACNA and UL listed. All cable hangers shall have a minimum of 4:1 safety margin over the listed Safe Working Load (SWL).

products.name: Sheet Metal Screws
products.description: Tinned, cadmium plated or rust resistant materials.

products.name: Machine Bolts
products.description: Tinned, cadmium plated or rust resistant materials. Button-head stove bolts, 1/4" x 3/4" unless otherwise specified.

products.name: Rivets
products.description: Tinned, cadmium plated or rust resistant materials.

products.name: Nuts
products.description: Tinned, cadmium plated or rust resistant materials.

products.name: Beam Clamps
products.description: For ducts with a cross sectional area of 2 square feet or less, clamp shall be Caddy Catalog Number 4H-Series Fig 2. For ducts with a cross sectional area of over 2 square feet, clamp shall be Fee & Mason 255L with locking nut and 255S retaining strap.

products.name: Welding Studs
products.description: Erico Fastening Systems, capacitor discharge, low carbon steel, copper flashed.

products.name: Structural (carbon) Steel Shapes and Steel Plates
products.normalized_name: Structural (carbon) Steel Shapes and Steel Plates
products.description: ASTM A36, shop primed.

products.name: Stainless Steel Shapes and Plates
products.description: ASTM A276 and ASTM A666.

products.name: Duct Sealant
products.description: Non-hardening, non-migrating mastic or liquid elastic sealant, type applicable for fabrication/installation detail, as compounded and recommended by manufacturer specifically for sealing joints and seams in ductwork in accordance with Article 2.02.A.3. Complies with SCAQMD Rule #1168 and LEED Version 4.0, Indoor Environmental Quality Section, Credit IEQ4.1 VOC limits.

products.name: Duct Cement
products.description: Non-hardening migrating mastic or liquid neoprene based cement, type applicable for fabrication/installation detail as compounded and recommended by manufacturer specifically for cementing fitting components, or longitudinal seams in ductwork in accordance with Article 2.02.A.3. Complies with SCAQMD Rule #1168 and LEED Version 4.0, Indoor Environmental Quality Section, Credit IEQ4.1 VOC limits.

products.name: Flexible Ducts
products.description: Either spiral-wound spring steel with flameproof vinyl sheathing, or corrugated aluminum; complying with UL 181. Where installed in unconditioned spaces other than return air plenums, provide 1" thick continuous flexible fiberglass sheath with vinyl vapor barrier jacket.

products.name: Underslab Ducts
products.description: For ductwork placed in concrete slabs, or under slabs on grade, fabricate ductwork of Vinyl Chloride Coated Steel or Stainless Steel. Shall comply with Section MC 603.8.

products.name: Fiberglass Duct Lining
products.description: Covered with a matte-faced neoprene covering and sealed with an acrylic polymer. Surface burning characteristics: flame spread index less than 25, smoke developed index less than 50 per ASTM E84 or UL 723. Shall not support fungi or bacterial growth per ASTM C1338, ASTM G21 and ASTM G22. Conforms to UL Publication No. 181 erosion test. Density: 1 1/2 lbs. per cubic foot, minimum of 1", unless otherwise indicated. Approved manufacturers: Owens Corning Aeroflex, Johns Manville Permacote Linacoustic, Certainteed Ultralite.

products.name: Non-erosive, open cell, fiber-free, polyimide foam material
products.normalized_name: Non-erosive, open cell, fiber-free, polyimide foam material
products.description: Foam maximum thermal conductivity shall be .35 BTU·in/h·°F·ft2. Foam surface burning characteristics: flame spread index less than 25, smoke developed index less than 50 per ASTM E84 or UL 723. Conforms to UL Publication No. 181 erosion test. Shall not support fungi or bacterial growth per ASTM C1338, ASTM G21 and ASTM G22. Coated with an acrylic polymer. Foam sound absorption coefficient: minimum of .65 NRC for 1' lining and .80 NRC for 1 1/2' lining. Johns Manville Polycoustic or approved equal.

products.name: Weld material
products.description: Shall match ductwork material. Galvanized ductwork welds to be cleaned and painted with galvanizing repair paint conforming to ASTM A780.

products.name: Factory-fabricated single wall round ductwork
products.description: Factory-fabricated duct and fittings, in lieu of shop-fabricated duct and fittings specified to be of galvanized construction in Article 2.02. Material: Galvanized sheet steel complying with ASTM A653, G60 coating designation; lockforming quality; mill-phosphatized finish for surfaces of ducts exposed to view. Gage as specified in SMACNA's HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Metal and Flexible Third Edition-2005. Approved Manufacturers: SEMCO Incorporated, Sheet Metal Connectors, Inc., McGill AirFlow LLC.

products.name: Factory-fabricated double wall duct and fittings
products.normalized_name: Factory-fabricated double wall duct and fittings
products.description: Factory-fabricated double wall duct and fittings for exposed ductwork in the Gymnasium and where indicated on the drawings. Double-wall ducts shall be fabricated with an outer duct that complies with HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Third Edition 2005. The smooth, inner duct (perforated or solid) shall be fabricated from a thinner material that protects the insulating material sandwiched between the inner and outer duct. The insulation shall have a 1' thick layer of fiberglass insulation: thermal conductivity: 0.26 BTU·in/h·°F·ft2 at 75°F mean temperature. Material: Galvanized steel of lock-forming quality conforming to ASTM A653 G60 coated; mill-phosphatized finish for surfaces of ducts exposed to view. Approved Manufacturers: Sheet Metal Connectors, Inc., SEMCO Incorporated, McGill AirFlow LLC.

products.name: Kitchen hood exhaust ducts and supports (carbon steel sheets)
products.normalized_name: Kitchen hood exhaust ducts and supports (carbon steel sheets)
products.description: Fabricated of carbon steel sheets complying with ASTM A1008/A1008M according to Section MC 506.3.1.1 based on cross sectional area.

products.name: Listed and labeled factory-built commercial kitchen grease ducts
products.normalized_name: Listed and labeled factory-built commercial kitchen grease ducts
products.description: Listed and labeled in accordance with UL 1978 and installed in accordance with Section MC 304.1 and as approved by the Commissioner.

products.name: Warming Pantry hood exhaust duct and supports (galvanized steel)
products.normalized_name: Warming Pantry hood exhaust duct and supports (galvanized steel)
products.description: 16 ga. minimum galvanized steel. For duct construction, comply with SMACNA: HVAC Duct Construction Standards, Third Edition-2005 and Section MC 506.

products.name: Grease duct enclosure assemblies
products.description: Recognized by the Office of Technical Certification and Research (OTCR) as grease duct enclosure assemblies which are tested, designed and evaluated in accordance with ICC-ES AC 101.21, Acceptance Criteria for Grease Duct Enclosure Assemblies. Such segmented grease duct systems shall have grease duct enclosure assemblies that have an evaluation or code compliance report issued in accordance with ICC-ES AC 101.2 and comply with conditions of Bulletin 2016-003. The agency providing the evaluation or code compliance report shall be accredited to ISO 17065.

products.name: Sound traps (packaged)
products.description: Packaged sound traps of proper models and sizes for the purpose of attenuating noise. Shall conform with the requirements tabulated on the Drawings. Approved Manufacturers: Industrial Acoustics Company, Koppers Co., Inc., Aeroacoustic Corp., Vibro-Acoustics, VAW Systems Inc., Price Industries, McGill AirFlow Corporation, Dynasonics, A PCI Industries Company.

products.name: Rectangular Sound Traps
products.description: Casings fabricated with a minimum of 0.034-inch thick, solid galvanized ASTM A653 sheet metal for outer casing and 0.022-inch thick, ASTM A653 perforated galvanized sheet metal for inner casing.

products.name: Round Sound Traps
products.description: Outer Casings: ASTM A653 galvanized sheet steel, thickness varies by diameter. Interior Casing, Partitions, and Baffles: ASTM A653 galvanized sheet steel, at least 0.034' thick and designed for minimum aerodynamic losses.

products.name: Fire-Resistive Duct Assemblies
products.description: May be rigid duct assemblies comprised of welded inner steel framework that is clad with a thick fire-resistant panel or factory manufactured commercial duct assemblies that are factory fabricated sheet metal duct system with additional applied fire resistive material. Recognized in accordance with ISO 6944, ASTM E 814/UL 1479, and ASTM E84.
